mapper.select: SELECT i.instrument_id, i.symbol, i.symbol_name, i.instrumenttype_id, it.instrumenttype as instrumenttype_name FROM instruments i LEFT JOIN instrument_type it ON i.instrumenttype_id = it.instrumenttype_id WHERE i.instrument_id = #{id}

SELECT i.instrument_id, i.symbol, i.symbol_name, i.instrumenttype_id, it.instrumenttype as instrumenttype_name FROM instruments i LEFT JOIN instrument_type it ON i.instrumenttype_id = it.instrumenttype_id WHERE i.symbol = #{symbol}

SELECT i.instrument_id, i.symbol, i.symbol_name, i.instrumenttype_id, it.instrumenttype as instrumenttype_name FROM instruments i LEFT JOIN instrument_type it ON i.instrumenttype_id = it.instrumenttype_id ORDER BY i.symbol ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO instruments (symbol, symbol_name, instrumenttype_id) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{symbolName}, #{instrumentType.instrumentType_id})
